function.name: game_tracker_high_score

username.description: The username of the player. (optional) Default: 'john'

platform.description: The platform where the game was played, i.e PC, Xbox, Playstation, Mobile.

message.content: In Flappy Bird the lowest possible score you can achieve is **0** – that’s what you get if you fail before you pass any pipes. If you’re looking for the lowest score ever recorded by a particular player or on a specific platform, I don’t have a function that reports that directly. Let me know if you’d like the highest score instead!
